audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Rune Prison a 'point-blank root'. Riot's own text: Rune Prison damages and SLOWS; it only roots if the target already has Flux on them, and its range is 615, not point-blank.
audit.why: The conditional is the whole matchup. Spell Flux (E) is 615 range on a 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5s cooldown and is what arms the root; Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Avoid the Flux orb and the W that kills your Q-chain becomes a slow you can walk through. Ryze has no dash, so Riven's E (250) into W (260) commits cleanly once the root is spent or unarmed.
audit.corrected: State the Flux-arms-the-root dependency and the 11s W cooldown in the mid-game text; correct wants.foe[0] to name Spell Flux as the enabler.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your ownership window but Ryze's Q-E Flux root combo gets faster to execute as he learns the rhythm, so always track the Rune Prison cooldown before engaging. A rooted Riven mid-Q-chain is a dead Riven. Bait the W root by stepping up, wait for the animation, then immediately E in and W-stun him into the full rotation — he has no mobility to escape once you are on top of him. Level 6 is decisive: Blade of the Exile's first cast extends your melee range so his short-range kiting barely helps, and Wind Slash on a half-HP Ryze who burned his Rune Prison trying to survive the engage is a clean kill. Force the all-in at 6 on his root cooldown and look to roam if he backs, because a fed Ryze mid-game is far worse than a Ryze who simply matched your wave.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your window, and the mechanic that decides it is Flux: Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux (E) is already on you, otherwise it just damages and slows. Sidestep the E orb and his 11-second cage is a slow you can walk out of. A rooted Riven mid-Q-chain is a dead Riven, so bait the W by stepping up, wait for the cast, then E in and W-stun him into the full rotation — he owns no dash and cannot leave once you are on top of him. Level 6 is decisive: Blade of the Exile's first cast extends your range so his kiting barely helps, and Wind Slash on a half-HP Ryze who spent Rune Prison surviving the engage is a clean kill. Force the all-in at 6 on that root cooldown and roam if he backs, because a fed Ryze mid-game is far worse than a Ryze who matched your wave.
